now.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
now.text: Frank now drives an armored Battle Van, and Spider-Man first meets him chasing a tank through the city.

proposed.text: Frank now drives an armored Battle Van, and runs into Spider-Man again while chasing a runaway tank through the city.

changes.evidence: In Spider-Man: Brand New Day the tank chase is not their first meeting: Frank and Spider-Man already know each other from an earlier clash over a drug cartel on Staten Island, which they keep bringing up, and Spider-Man later asks Frank for help as a favor for what they did at Staten Island.

now.title: Daredevil S2
now.text: In episode 10, Frank's wife Maria and their children, Lisa and Frank Jr., die in a gang shootout in Central Park during a sting the DA let go ahead.
cases: ST-040 The Central Park Massacre (Daredevil S2)

changes.evidence: Maria, Lisa and Frank Jr. are killed in the shootout at the Central Park carousel (the Massacre at Central Park), which the record itself names, and the app has a Central Park place. The record shows no place.

now.title: Daredevil S3
now.text: In episode 12, Nadeem testifies against Fisk before a rigged grand jury and is killed by Dex.

changes.evidence: Nadeem testifies at the New York State Supreme Court Building in Manhattan, but Dex kills him at the Nadeem Residence, which is in Queens (Daredevil S3 episode 12). The record's death has no place, and the app has Queens.

now.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
now.text: Beaten by Spider-Man, the Hand's remnants become Damage Control's security, until Jean Grey turns them against him.
cases: ST-135 The Roosevelt Island Incident (Spider-Man: Brand New Day)

changes.evidence: The record ends with Jean Grey taking over Snow's Hand ninja, who guard Damage Control's Roosevelt Island facility, and setting them on Spider-Man there. This matches the case ST-135 The Roosevelt Island Incident. The record shows no place, and the app has Roosevelt Island.
